summary: Studio Identity & Conversion Sprint testing. Fixed critical bug: /servizi and /consulenza were redirecting to /auth/login due to missing entries in api.js isPublicSurface list. After fix, all pages load correctly. Found CMS data issue: /about page has '/begin-journey' hrefs in 4 sections (should be '/consulenza').

integration_issues.issue: CMS data for /about page has '/begin-journey' in settings.cta_primary_href (hero_editorial, team_identity_card, design_journey, cinematic_quote sections). Should be '/consulenza'. Code fallback is '/consulenza' but CMS override takes precedence.

action_items: Update CMS data for /about page: change cta_primary_href from '/begin-journey' to '/consulenza' for sections: hero_editorial, team_identity_card, design_journey, cinematic_quote. Use a migration script or admin panel to update storefront sections for page_key='about', tenant_slug='studio'.
critical_code_review_comments: api.js isPublicSurface list was missing '/servizi' and '/consulenza' — FIXED in this iteration. Main agent should review all newly added public routes and ensure they are listed in isPublicSurface in /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js
/consulenza page shows 'Design Journey™' as internal form navigation label — this is acceptable as it's the form UI, not a public SaaS branding mention

test_results.homepage_finalcta: PASS - 'Pronti a trasformare il vostro spazio?' visible
test_results.professionals_hero: PASS - 'La tua competenza, il nostro metodo.' loaded
test_results.servizi_loads: PASS (after fix) - 'Dal concept alla consegna chiavi.' visible
test_results.about_cta_begin_journey: FAIL - CMS data still has '/begin-journey' in 4 sections (hero_editorial, team_identity_card, design_journey, cinematic_quote)

rca_of_issue: Root cause of /servizi and /consulenza redirect to login: /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js has a global 401 interceptor that redirects to /auth/login unless the current path is in the 'isPublicSurface' list. The new routes '/servizi' and '/consulenza' were not added to this list when they were created. Fix: added these paths to isPublicSurface list. Root cause of /about begin-journey links: CMS seed data for the about page was seeded with '/begin-journey' hrefs and was not updated when '/consulenza' was introduced as the new CTA route.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fixed: /servizi and /consulenza no longer redirect to login (api.js isPublicSurface fix). Remaining issue: /about page CMS data has '/begin-journey' in 4 section settings - needs DB update. Use: GET /api/storefront/public/studio/pages/about to see current data and update sections via admin panel or migration. All other sprint features verified working: homepage nav CTA, footer clean, professionals page full CMS content, servizi page full CMS content, consulenza loads BeginJourneyPage.
